key_insight: Diffusion generation expands ABX₃ perovskite structural and chemical coverage, but reliable bandgap-targeted discovery requires topology checks and property validation.
engineering_relevance: For solar-cell materials screening, generated perovskites offer candidate diversity rather than validated absorber performance.
method: Generate ABX₃ candidates with a pretrained crystal diffusion model.
Filter for three-dimensional corner-sharing perovskite connectivity.
Evaluate ALIGNN bandgap predictions and perform first-principles checks on six structures.
evidence_signal: The generated target-window fraction was 8.2% versus 7.3% for Materials Project, while ALIGNN failed to outperform a constant baseline on a severe B-site-disjoint test.
watch_item: Different MatterGen and ALIGNN label sources prevent claiming target-condition enrichment; relaxation can change topology, and calculated gaps can differ appreciably from predictions.
paper_title: Diffusion-Based Generative Screening of ABX$_3$ Perovskite Compositions for Bandgap-Targeted Materials Discovery
